question: The first woman to win the Dronacharya Award was weightlifting coach ______ in 2000.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hansa Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hansa Sharma **is a **prominent weightlifting coach from India.**
 
• **She became the first woman** to receive the **Dronacharya Award in 2000.**
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is a prestigious **sports coaching honour in India, awarded for exceptional contributions to mentoring athletes.**
 
• **Hansa Sharma's achievement** marked a significant moment in Indian sports, opening doors for other women coaches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Important Information
 
 
 
 

 Renu Kohli
 Athletics
 Renu Kohli is an athletics coach who won the Dronacharya Award in 2002, becoming the second woman to receive this honor​.
 
 

 Sunita Sharma
 Cricket
 
 
Sunita Sharma is reportedly India's first woman cricket coach.

 
She has trained dozens of first-class and international cricketers and received the Dronacharya Award in 2005 for the year 2004.

 
 
 

 Purnima Mahato
 Archery
 
 
Purnima Mahato is an Indian archer and archery coach.

 
She has won the Indian national archery championships and a silver medal at the 1998 Commonwealth Games.

 
She was a coach for the Indian national team at the 2008 and 2012 Summer Olympics. She received the Dronacharya Award in 2013​.
